title: Grateful Dead Live at Dream Bowl on 1969-02-21
lineage: SBD > MR > ? > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard captures a raging 1969 show highlighted by an unforgettable Eleven, scorching Dark Star and soaring St. Stephen.
ai_review.review: The recording is a surprisingly clear sound‑board capture of the February 21, 1969 Dream Bowl performance, with only a faint high‑frequency hiss noted by one listener. Musically the night is fire‑hot – The Eleven is described as spellbinding, Dark Star “tasty,” and St. Stephen “totally radical,” while Jerry Garcia’s guitar is repeatedly praised for “ragging” beyond limits. A few gripes focus on a chaotic ending to Doin’ That Rag, but overall the energy is sky‑high and the set flows tightly.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (≈70%) give enthusiastic 4–5 star ratings and highlight standout jams; recording is repeatedly called crystal‑clear with only minor hiss issues, yielding a strong combined show + recording score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and well balanced soundboard tape; a few listeners mention a faint high‑frequency hiss throughout, but overall clarity is excellent for a 1969 source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, cohesive flow with powerful second‑set jams; many note this performance as tighter and better played than other Dream Bowl shows from the same era.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for ripping, “ragin’” his guitar and surpassing limits of the mind during the jams.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for a colorful outburst at the end of Doin' That Rag; otherwise bass work is not specifically highlighted but contributes to the overall power.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey’s aggressive scream/cussing captured in Doin' That Rag; drumming otherwise solid and supportive of the high‑energy jams.
